newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged, buyers absent.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged, buyers absent.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were unchanged in late trading on Wednesday amid sustained thin buying interest, traders said.
They said June/July shipment SIR20 offers were quoted at 50.75-51.00 U.S.cents/lb fob Medan, 50.75 cents fob Surabaya, 50.50 cents fob Palembang and Padang, and 50.25 cents Jambi.
The traders also said that tyre-maker Goodyear Tire had bid 50.25 cents in Medan on Tuesday, but were unsure if any deals had been done at that level.
"The market continued to remain quiet," one trader said. "There were no fresh bids or enquiries."
Another trader said the Goodyear bid was considered low, and that he was not keen on selling at that price level.
"Buyers are trying to sqeeze prices, which are already very low," he said. "I would rather hold on to my rubber instead of selling at these low bid prices."
The trader said he expected prices to remain weak through the week in the absence of buyers.
